vson_p:
# Mass / Substance: water pouring -- countability=Mass, no Count.
# Demonstrates: Substance class + countability=Mass + a Process (durative).

(scene / Composition
   :framedBy (cam / CameraView :angle eye_level :focalLength 85mm :framing close_up)
   :viewedBy cam
   :depicts (jug / PhysicalObject
               :individuation Generic :animacy Inert :countability Count
               :class Vessel
               :hasQuality (qm / Quality :dimension Material :value ceramic))
   :depicts (water / Substance
               :individuation Generic
               :animacy Inert
               :countability Mass
               :class Water)
   :occurs (pour / Process
              :lemma pour
              :agent jug
              :theme water))
